resources.fontCache: OS font files were read for hashing before a fresh browser/Worker document open.
resources.method: All browser subprocesses in the imposed cgroup; workers share renderer RSS. Sum of observed per-process kernel VmHWM is a conservative bound over their nonconcurrent peaks and includes shared pages repeatedly. Processes/threads are sampled; short-lived processes can escape observation. Kernel cgroup memory.peak supplements the sampled record. Absolute browser bounds are stronger than document-incremental bounds.
